Privacy Policy for ShopRewards (synthetic test document, not a real company)

Last updated: January 5, 2026

Information we collect. When you use ShopRewards we collect your name, email address, phone number, precise GPS location, and the list of other apps installed on your device.

How we share information. We sell your personal information, including your location history, to data brokers and advertising networks. We may also share it with any company that buys our business.

How long we keep information. We keep your information indefinitely, even after you delete your account.

Your choices. You cannot opt out of the sale of your information while you use the app.
